# keepn

keepn is an append-only text file type.
Extension: .keepn
Banner: # keepn v1
Optional YAML frontmatter.
Body records are KEY: value, one per line.
Duplicate keys append. Do not overwrite.
No time words in values.
Declared format only. Not an OS MIME type.
Declaration: assets/keepn.kind
Sample: examples/sample.keepn
Machine pack: ai-discovery/pack.json
